name: Sander Dongelmans
openerText:
Hi Sander, the ColSensation login system and the Peulvruchten recipe module are more range than most five person studios have!

However, the team page lists one developer, and Sterke Zaak sells login systems and custom modules as a whole service line. This means you're either quoting a date you don't like or passing on the work you're best at.

I run Astra agency, we build websites and the tools that sit on them, with senior developers sitting behind the Dutch side, after a year and a half at Betty Blocks watching studios hit this exact wall.

Shall I send a short note on how we'd split one of your builds?
research: SUPERSEDES prior UNRESEARCHED. Identified via LinkedIn slug sanderdongelmans, headline Webontwikkelaar at Sterke Zaak. Fetched sterkezaak.nl (WordPress 7.1), /over/ and /diensten/tools-geavanceerde-systemen/. Team page names five people, Marc Vermeule creatie en eigenaar, Sander webdeveloper, Kim creatie en fotografie, Bianca office, Wessel vormgever, so Sander is the only developer. The tools page sells a receptenmodule built for Peulvruchten.nl, interactive animations for waterschap Brabantse Delta and a full login system for ColSensation. FALSIFICATION, the /over/ page names external partners as tekstmakers, beeldmakers and drukkerijen only, no development partner, so the single developer claim survives. Build Squad angle, not a criticism of the site.

name: Lee Matthews
openerText:
Hi Lee, the line in your August post about the value you left on the table in your first business because you didn't know any better is a rare thing to put in writing!

However, the homepage asks whether someone knows what their business is really worth, and the only way to find out is booking a review. This means the founder who's curious at 11pm and not ready to talk to anyone closes the tab, and you never learn he was there.

I run Astra agency, we build websites and the tools on them, after building a food brand from zero with my family where I ran the pricing and the P&L.

Shall I build a scoring version of that question and send it over?
research: SUPERSEDES prior UNRESEARCHED. Slug lee-matthews-a1a65827, Founder at Matvelo. Fetched matvelo.co.uk home, /insights/, /our-services/matvelo-business-health-check/, /contact-us/. FALSIFICATION CAUGHT A WRONG ANGLE. The insights URLs read example-blog-1 through 4 which looked like unpublished theme placeholders, but fetching /2026/04/07/example-blog-2/ returns a real article titled Fundamentals of Effective Leadership, so only the slugs are leftover and the placeholder claim would have been false. The angle used instead is verified, the homepage asks Do you know how valuable your business really is and When was the last time you checked, and every route on every service page is Book A Discovery Call or Book Your Business Review. No self assessment exists anywhere on the site.

openerText:

However, your careers page is two lines, Senior Engineer and Principal Engineer, with no description and no way to apply, while you're hiring into growing demand. This means a principal engineer who's looking reads two words and goes back to a recruiter, and you pay an agency fee for someone who'd have come direct.

I run Astra agency, we build websites and the tools on them, after two years at a B2B software company building the routing that decides who actually gets replied to.

Shall I write up both roles as real pages with an application flow?

Three directors, Paul Thurlwell, Sudhakara Karri, Matt Holmes, established 2006, award winning, real projects A57 Hyde Road, A27 and A270 Brighton, new Clyde Bridge replacing a 1912 reinforced concrete bridge, Hednesford Station stairs with Taziker. A news post states they are recruiting a Senior Engineer to meet growing demand. News feed latest post is 19 September 2023, 50 posts total.

openerText:
Hi Katie, saw Risk Averse flies drone surveys alongside the RICS homebuyer work, and that you wrote a whole page on when someone should actually instruct one rather than just selling it. Good spread!

However, two items in your own top nav point at URLs WordPress invented. That survey timing guide lives at riskaverseltd.co.uk/no-title/, and the EPC page sits under /services/3753-2/. They load fine, they just read like nobody came back to finish. This means a buyer three weeks into a chain, comparing surveyors at 10pm, sees a chartered firm whose site has a page called no title, and there's no way to ask for a quote on the homepage anyway.

I run Astra agency. We build websites and the tools that go on them. I built a brand from zero with my family, so I know which jobs don't get finished.

Shall I rebuild the survey pages with real URLs and a quote request on each, and send it over?

RICS Chartered Building Surveyors, Rochdale, residential and commercial surveys, drone surveys and EPCs. She read Building Surveying at Salford and ran a chocolate fountain business at 18 before this. WordPress on the free Primer theme. THE FINDING, verified by fetching each URL. Two items in the live top navigation point at WordPress auto generated placeholder slugs. The nav item labelled When should you instruct a survey links to riskaverseltd.co.uk/no-title/, which returns 200 with that heading, and the EPC nav item links to /services/3753-2/, which returns 200 with the heading Energy Services. Both confirmed present in the rendered menu markup, not guessed. FLOW. Homepage, /services/, /no-title/ and /3753-2/ all carry 0 forms and 0 inputs. Surveys are an urgent time boxed purchase for someone inside a chain, so the missing homepage quote route is the cost.

However, you're running two brands on two platforms. yoosdesign.nl is four pages on the One.com editor, yoosoffice.nl is a separate Shopify shop, and the design side takes no booking anywhere except one form on the contact page. This means someone who lands on the shop for a bureaustoel never finds out you'd do their whole floor.

I run Astra agency. We build websites and the tools that go on them. I built a brand from zero with my family and ran the pricing and the stock, so two storefronts and one pair of hands is a problem I recognise.

Shall I build the page that puts both YOOS offers in front of the same visitor and send it over?

openerText:

However, that result is doing all the work on its own. research: Fetched clearmind-solutions.de and /cases. The homepage carries 0 forms and 2 mailto links. name: Adrian Mann
openerText:
Hi Adrian, saw the boat make list on your quote form, running from Absolute and Adams right through to Alubat and Alwoplast. Somebody did proper work on that!

However, getting a price means eight steps and about a hundred fields. Step three asks for years of experience, past claims and criminal convictions, and that's before you've reached the boat. This means the owner who can get a broker on the phone and a number in four minutes meets something that feels like a mortgage application, and the ones who stop halfway leave no name, so you never find out they were there.

I run Astra agency. We build websites and the tools that go on them. I built a food brand from zero with my family and ran the pricing, so I've watched what an extra step does to people who had already decided to buy.

Shall I rebuild the quote as a short first step that captures the enquiry, with the rest after, and send it over?
research: Fetched homepage, /quote/ and the nav. WordPress on the bought HighendWP theme with WPBakery. The quote page carries 2 forms and 103 inputs across 8 numbered steps. Step 1 name, email, phone, date of birth. Step 2 address. Step 3 years of experience, claims in the past 5 years, criminal convictions or DUIs, other named operators. Step 4 vessel details with a make dropdown listing several hundred builders from Absolute to Amel and beyond. Commercial marine enquiries are pushed to an email address instead. No price published anywhere so no figure was written.
claims: the quote page runs 8 steps with about 103 inputs
step 3 asks years of experience, claims in the past 5 years and criminal convictions or DUIs
the vessel make dropdown lists several hundred builders starting Absolute, Adams, Admiral
commercial marine enquiries are directed to an email address instead of the form

However, your cookie banner is only switched on for Austria. This causes German visitors to be tracked by Meta, Taboola, Microsoft and Google Ads without being asked, on a site about snoring and sleep apnoea.

Especially, when you are growing Snorly on paid ads, the exposure grows with every ad click from Germany, and since the BGH ruling last year a competitor can send you an Abmahnung over it.

I run Astra agency. We build websites and apps for brands like Unilever, AXA, Pertamina. I led e business data and its governance across 23 markets at Heineken, so I've had to keep the tracking legal without losing the numbers.

Shall I send you over what the banner setup for Germany looks like?

name: Shilpi Arora
replyText:
Honestly the sentence, most people we meet have the tool pictured and no idea yet how to say what it's for, so your end is the harder one.

Which is partly why I'm curious about your setup. Your services page has the site build in there too, design and development, and you're doing all of it yourself. Do you enjoy the build side, or is it the part you'd hand off if you could? We've got a squad of developers who build for other studios in half the time at half the price, so the founder can stay on the strategy and the clients.
